data.narrative:
Synchron is a Series D biotech company founded by Tom Oxley and Rahul Sharma that has raised over $200M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 3 public-market peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private companies at the same or adjacent stage, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and New Limit.

Two valuation methods prove applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using the $200M total raised as a proxy base value and applying a typical 1.5x Series D step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $300M. Peer-median anchoring across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $3.8B, with a range spanning $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-comp P/S anchoring cannot be applied due to absence of revenue disclosure for the target.

The triangulation of these two methods supports a valuation range of $255M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median point of $2.0B. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around whether Synchron trades closer to recent-stage capital inputs or to later-stage peer multiples. Key variables include the company's progress toward clinical or commercial milestones, capital efficiency, and whether recent fundraising rounds have captured material value inflection.
